chat_message_body_length.name: chat_message_body_length
chat_message_body_length.value: "chat_message"."kind" <> 'message' or "chat_message"."deleted_at" is not null or coalesce(char_length("chat_message"."body"), 0) between 1 and 500

question_dates_order.name: question_dates_order
question_dates_order.value: "question"."opens_at" is null or "question"."closes_at" is null or "question"."opens_at" < "question"."closes_at"

question_published_complete.name: question_published_complete
question_published_complete.value: "question"."status" <> 'published' or ("question"."opens_at" is not null and "question"."closes_at" is not null and "question"."season_id" is not null)

season_standing_score.name: season_standing_score
season_standing_score.value: "season_standing"."malus" is not null or "season_standing"."points" is not null
